prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: university research laboratory website research-area cover, one single standalone image. Create a sophisticated photorealistic 3D editorial visualization with realistic materials and clear topic-specific objects, not a stock-photo collage. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, preferably 1536x864 or 2048x1152. Quiet warm-white studio environment, slate blue and muted teal accents that suit a white academic website, subtle warm highlights, soft daylight, refined shadows, calm spacious composition. The main subject and all important details must remain inside the central 75% of the image so modest 16:9 and 3:2 crops are safe. Distinct recognizable subject, elegant and tangible. No titles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, no human faces, no humanoid heads, no glowing brains, no generic neon network sphere. This is a conceptual research illustration, not a depiction of an actual laboratory or validated scientific result. Topic: Artificial intelligence and representation learning. A carefully constructed layered learning architecture made of translucent glass sheets and precise small nodes, with distinct abstract image patches and a compact optical sensor at its input, resolving into organized feature clusters at its output. Physically arranged tabletop scientific sculpture, clear depth and restrained visual complexity. Emphasize learning patterns from diverse observations.
